process_steps.activity_description: New customer first contact (initial inquiry intake).
process_steps.remarks: WhatsApp for first contact. No standard inquiry template exists.

process_steps.activity_description: Sales receives inquiry and performs background verification.
process_steps.remarks: No formal verification SOP. Process is ad hoc and varies by salesperson. KYC form sent to new customer and must be returned before quotation proceeds.

process_steps.activity_description: KYC form sent to and completed by new customer.
process_steps.remarks: Customer delay is common. No tracking system for outstanding KYC forms. Finance approval required before any booking is released for new customers.

process_steps.activity_description: Existing customer contacts Sales or CS directly for rate / booking.
process_steps.remarks: ~35â€“40 inquiries per day across the team with no centralised tracking. No CRM in use. Dropped or unconverted inquiries are invisible â€” no conversion rate data available. Existing customers bypass formal onboarding and communicate directly with CS.

process_steps.activity_description: CS checks AMS for contracted or monthly rates.
process_steps.remarks: AMS holds contracted rates (fixed 1â€“6 months) and monthly rates (15-day validity). Spot rates are absent from AMS. Not all liner rates are always updated â€” gaps exist when liners have not yet issued new rate sheets. AMS is not linked to Gensoft.

process_steps.activity_description: If rate unavailable in AMS, CS requests rate from Procurement.
process_steps.remarks: Informal channel â€” WhatsApp group used for all rate requests. Process is undocumented with no SLA. Risk of delays when procurement team is unavailable. Spot rates are never stored centrally after retrieval.

process_steps.activity_description: Procurement retrieves rate from shipping line and updates AMS.
process_steps.remarks: Each liner sends rate sheets on different schedules (daily, 15-day, monthly). ~12 shipping lines total; 80% of volume through 4â€“5 main carriers (US: ~70% via MSC). Rates not always current in AMS at point of inquiry. Spot rates never stored centrally.

process_steps.activity_description: Sales determines markup and quotes customer.
process_steps.remarks: No standardised markup guidelines. Markup is 100% salesperson judgment. Very low or zero-margin deals accepted without approval. Quotation options (Option 1, 2, 3) may be given. Gensoft has quotation module but it is not used. Subject to space availability for spot rates.
